Definition
[Minimizing sequence] ↗ def:admissible-class-sobolev-minimization 1. ch8:8.2.1-def-3\group Existence of Minimizers

We call a sequence $\{ u_k\} _{k=1}^{\infty } \subset \mathcal{A}$ satisfying (7), i.e. $I[u_k]\to m := \inf _{w\in \mathcal{A}} I[w]$, a minimizing sequence.
